_doc: Read by scripts/offline/audit-gate.mjs in .github/workflows/dependency-audit.yml. Each entry accepts ONE advisory on ONE package until its expiry date; after that it blocks again. Add one only with a written reason and the decision that allowed it. Remove an entry once no audited lockfile (root, mcp-server, cli) matches it any more.

exceptions.reason: DoS while parsing form data from a remote functions `form`. Reckons.AI builds with adapter-static and has no server, no *.remote.ts file, no $app/server import and no remoteFunctions option (checked 2026-11-17), so the vulnerable code path does not run. Fixed only in @sveltejs/kit 3.2.0, which fails our build today (Dependabot #641).
exceptions.decided: MATT, 2026-11-17 (AskUserQuestion): 'Named exception + migrate' — exception for this advisory id only, and the SvelteKit 3 migration starts on its own branch.

exceptions.reason: Private `query.batch` remote functions could collide. Reckons.AI defines no remote functions (static build; checked 2026-11-17). Fixed only in @sveltejs/kit 3.2.0.
